In today's Daily Fix:
For years Resident Evil 5 has been the series' best-selling game, with a little over 19 million copies sold. Now the Resident Evil 2 remake has overtaken it, with around 19.75 million units. Across the entire series, the games have sold over 213 million copies worldwide. In other news, Spider-Man: Brand New Day is swinging toward a massive opening weekend domestically, with projections placing it in the $180-$190 million range. And that's among the more conservative estimates. And in related news, Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is being updated with two new Spidey suits: one from Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls and another from Brand New Day.

author: IGN
description:
The Steam Machine is an awesome little system with serious gaming chops and cute aesthetics. It makes a great entry-point for PC gaming if you’ve been sitting on the sidelines for a while and want a console-like experience with some added PC functionality. But like everything else in 2026, they’re a bit expensive, and like everything Valve makes, hard to buy right now. 

Fortunately, along with releasing the Steam Machine to the masses, Valve also dropped an updated version of SteamOS which works well with AMD GPUs, making it much easier to build your own homebrew Steam Machine. We’ve gone through more retailer listings than we can count and come up with a DIY Steam Machine that, according to our testing, will outperform the Steam Machine by as much as 18%, for (slightly) less money. 

Here's the full part list:

CPU: AMD Ryzen 5X 7600X - https://zdcs.link/z7G1Jn 
CPU Cooler: Thermalright Assassin X120 - https://zdcs.link/9w0eLA 
Motherboard: ASRock B650M-HDV - https://zdcs.link/92peL
title: Steam Machine vs PC: How to Build a Custom Steam Machine for Less Than Valve
